ns2:course.label: Cond/Teach Strings-Grp Setting
ns2:course.description: Survey of concert and training literature for school orchestras; refinement of fundamental concepts of gesture; development of advanced skills in conducting, score reading, and score analysis. Prerequisite: MUS 242; music education majors, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MUS 242; music education majors, or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing. Restricted to BME:Mus Ed:Choral Music-UIUC, BME:MusEd:Instrmntl Music-UIUC, BME:Mus Ed:Elem Gen Music-UIUC, or MME:Music Education -UIUC.
